engine_input.comment: The Firefox release the Nulavio build ships, and the SHA-256 of its source tarball from Mozilla's signed SHA256SUMS. Change both with scripts/release/bump_engine.py <version> (it verifies the signature), in the commit that moves the build to a new release. scripts/release/watch_upstream.py compares the version with Mozilla's releases (update policy, docs/architecture/update-policy.md); scripts/upstream/fetch_firefox_source.py refuses a tarball that differs from this digest.
